invariants: Only verified adult stakeholders such as parents, guardians, teachers, school staff, or other adult product evaluators may be contacted.
No direct communication with a minor is permitted.
No child personal data, health data, school records, credentials, precise location, or other private child information may be requested or stored.
No experiment may alter a child-facing production experience, curriculum, game economy, school workflow, or educational content.
The bounded validation is limited to one external message per experiment and remains subject to action-engine rate limits, idempotency, kill switches, and evidence requirements.
Consequential child-facing changes remain human-approval required and outside the bounded action engine.
